name: Luu
source: "Luu is a scientist that works for a planetary corporation called hyper jell inc and is stuck trying to figure out how to save her planet while overcoming her own flaws. Slimes are timid by nature and never really speak out in fear of being the centre of attention. This is made worse because the current government brands slimes that have anything negative to say about hyper jell inc as terrorists; they are never seen again."
